name: openwa-desktop
description: OpenWA Desktop - Electron shell that embeds the OpenWA WhatsApp gateway locally
author: Yudhi Armyndharis & OpenWA Contributors

scripts.start: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:gateway && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run rebuild && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:gateway:prod && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run rebuild && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:gateway:prod && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:win: npm run rebuild && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:gateway:prod && electron-builder --win nsis portable
